messages:
Alex: Kicking off a small midroll for release v2.7.1 now — shifting 10% traffic to `redwood-alpha-quant` (commit abc123). Preflight targets: p95 < 250ms, errors < 0.5%, 5xx < 0.1%. Watching embed-service and chat routes.
Deploy-bot: traffic-shift started -> variant=redwood-alpha-quant percent=10 commit=abc123 initiator=Alex
Metrics-bot: snapshot: p95=198ms (ok), errors=0.18% (ok), 5xx=0.02% (ok). Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/rollouts/2478001234
Ria: seeing a small 429 blip on embed-service in eu-west (spike from 0 -> ~45/min). Not yet 5xx but client throttles.
Carol: logs from embed-service:
```
2026-03-20T12:05:10Z embed-handler warn: client-rate-limit 429 user=svc-frontend shard=3
2026-03-20T12:05:12Z cache miss storm: kvcache miss=0.84 latency-ms=12
```
Ria: looks like kvcache miss surge coincident with shift, maybe prefix mismatch on new variant.
Nate: if it's kvcache schema mismatch, we should pin embed route to prev variant until we patch. Rolling back 10% would be quick.
Sam: +1 to pinning. Recommend temporary route override: `redwood route set embed-service variant=redwood-stable percent=100 --reason "rollout throttle"` — anyone want to trigger?
Alex: hold for 2 checks — give me next metrics tick (1 minute). If errors continue to burn, roll back.
Metrics-bot: canary update: p95=212ms, errors=0.42%, 429s on embed-service eu-west=68/min, error_budget_burn=7%/min
Ria: error budget burn trending up quickly, eu-west only. Other regions stable.
Carol: quick grep of recent deploy shows `kvcache-key-prefix` default changed in alpha variant (misses expected). I've got a patch ready, but it needs hotfix build.
Alex: decision: do not continue ramp. Pin embed-service back to stable to stop budget burn. Nate — can you apply the route override?
Nate: running now: `redwood route override --service embed-service --variant redwood-stable --duration 30m --note "rollback due to kv miss/429 spike"`
Deploy-bot: route override accepted -> service=embed-service variant=redwood-stable duration=30m initiated_by=Nate
Metrics-bot: post-override snapshot (30s later): p95=190ms, errors=0.09%, 429s embed eu-west=4/min, error_budget_burn=0.6%/min
Sam: thanks — looks healthy. Agree to hold rollback and keep the rest of midroll paused.
Alex: I'll mark the release as paused for embed route. Sam, please add note to release notes and create follow-up to ensure kvcache prefix test in preflight.
Sam: added release note: "v2.7.1: rolled back embed-service route due to kv cache key prefix mismatch causing 429s in eu-west; patch planned; midroll paused." -> ticket #INC-4821 created for follow-up.
Ria: when patch is ready, we should smoke in staging with kvcache probe and then try a 5% canary in eu-west only.
Carol: working on hotfix build now (target in ~18m). Will post artifact and smoke checklist.
Alex: nice quick triage team, :thumbsup: — closing this watch thread. I'll update the change window notes to reflect the partial pin.
Sam: :eyes: adding the postmortem template entry to the ticket.
Deploy-bot: action log -> pin applied, midroll paused, followup ticket=INC-4821, actors=[Alex,Nate,Sam,Carol]
